lines.text: [tired, quiet] Night log. December sixth. Two-twenty A.M.
lines.asr: Night log December sixth two twenty AM

lines.text: [low, uneasy] Four of them. None of them has moved.
lines.sub: FOUR OF THEM. NONE OF THEM HAS MOVED.
lines.asr: Four of them None of them has moved

lines.text: [whispering, uneasy] It's on its stand. It never left.
lines.sub: IT'S ON ITS STAND. IT NEVER LEFT.
lines.asr: It's on its stand It never left

lines.text: [whispering, terrified] Then what's holding the shutter?
